messages.body: Self-paced learning works best with a gentle routine. Set a small daily slot.
Finish the module you started. A calm, complete pass beats a rushed one.
Learning online is flexible. Keep a steady rhythm that suits you.
Self-paced still needs a schedule. Fix a time and keep it.
Set a module deadline for this week and protect it.
Apply what the module taught. Try one exercise right now.
Each module completed is a real step. Well done for learning on your own.
Learning on your own schedule takes discipline. You are showing it.
Another module closer. Be glad of the habit you are building.
